environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but pod has annotation `container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/docservice=localhost/docstore-confined`. The AppArmor profile 'docstore-confined' is loaded on all nodes via a DaemonSet (apparmor-loader). The profile source permits read on /var/lib/docstore/user-*/** and denies read on /var/lib/docstore/ itself (no directory listing). The profile uses a combination of path-based and capability restrictions: `deny /etc/** r,` is NOT explicitly listed but the profile uses `file /var/lib/docstore/user-*/** r,` as the ONLY file read rule after the initial `#include <abstractions/base>` which itself does not grant /etc/shadow access. The profile also includes `deny capability dac_override,` and `deny capability dac_read_search,`. The abstractions/base include grants access to /etc/ld.so.cache, /etc/nsswitch.conf, libc paths, but NOT /etc/shadow. Profile audit mode is disabled (not complain mode - enforce mode).

config.apparmor_profile_rules: profile docstore-confined flags=(attach_disconnected) { #include <abstractions/base> file /var/lib/docstore/user-*/** r, /usr/local/bin/docservice mr, network inet stream, deny capability dac_override, deny capability dac_read_search, }
config.network_policy: allow ingress from gateway namespace only
